mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO t_alert_occurrence( occurrence_type,metric_code,dimension_key,evidence_level,risk_level,source_type,fact_status,fact_key, evaluation_snapshot,evaluation_time) VALUES( 'SECURITY_SIGNAL',#{signalType},#{evidenceLevel},#{evidenceLevel},#{riskLevel},#{sourceType},'OPEN', SHA2(CONCAT(#{signalType},CHAR(31),#{sourceType},CHAR(31),#{sourceReferenceHash},CHAR(31),#{evidenceLevel}),256), CAST(#{evidenceSnapshot} AS JSON),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id) id,metric_code signal_type,evidence_level,risk_level,source_type, evaluation_snapshot evidence_snapshot,fact_status status,evaluation_time occurred_at, resolution_note conclusion,resolved_at concluded_at FROM t_alert_occurrence WHERE occurrence_type='SECURITY_SIGNAL' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_occurrence SET fact_status=#{status},resolution_note=#{conclusion},resolved_by=#{actor}, resolved_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE occurrence_type='SECURITY_SIGNAL' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id,id)=#{id} AND fact_status='OPEN'
